The issuer displays exceptionally strong financial performance, characterized by high-scale revenue ($17.6B in Q3 alone), an outstanding gross margin of 83%, a very high operating margin of 48%, and robust profitability with a net income of $5.58B. While the leverage ratio is somewhat elevated (total liabilities of $91.1B against total assets of $114.9B), the company's ample liquidity (current ratio of 1.55 on $62.1B in current assets) and massive cash-generation capacity represent an extremely low default risk. This profile aligns with a strong investment-grade rating in the high-single-A category.

DECISION: A+
